title: The Map Talked, Not Drawn
youtube_title: The Map Talked, Not Drawn | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A story belongs to the person still speaking it.
summary: At a library window seat, the ferryman begins to tell Tamsin about a map described in words because the paper was wet. Tamsin wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
